note: Reject vectors whose single mutation cannot be measured as a change to a parsed value. Each is still one contiguous edit of one line of its parent's text, which the pairing test checks.

human-clean--depth-129.reason: A value nested past the bound cannot be parsed to be compared; the edit replaces one string value with nested arrays.

human-clean--duplicate-member.reason: A duplicate member is invisible once parsed (the second occurrence replaces the first); the edit repeats one member.

human-clean--unpaired-surrogate.reason: A string with an unpaired surrogate is not a valid Unicode string and cannot be parsed to be compared; the edit appends one escape to one string.
